name: stripecard
title: Stripe Style Card
description: A compact dark card pairing a coastal photo with a blue logo block, heading, short body copy and a Learn link that slides in when the card is hovered.
use: A SaaS or fintech page needs a compact card that teases a service and reveals a call to action on hover.
avoid: Touch screens: the Learn link only appears on hover, so keyboard and mobile users may never see it.
a11y: The Learn link only appears on hover, so it stays invisible when focused by keyboard, and the alt text 'shoes' does not match the cliff photo. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark charcoal card, portrait shaped, holding a photo of pale sea cliffs across its upper two-thirds. Below sit a small blue rounded square, a bold white heading, two lines of grey body text and a blue 'Learn about Atlas' link with a chevron.
behaves: On hover the photo rises and scales, a blue gradient washes over its left side, and the Learn link fades up into view; the image area shrinks slightly to make room. Everything eases back to the resting state when the pointer leaves.
customise: All copy, the image path and the blue palette are written inside the component; changing them means editing the file. No props are exposed.
weight: light: One image and a handful of CSS transitions; no JavaScript animation loop.
